lessons: Call troops and recruit strictly from the offered list every turn when cash allows; never skip recruitment to hoard money or drill idle units.
Never leave Washington empty; maintain a dedicated garrison and fortify to level 2 early to crush any Confederate offensive.
Secure neutral border cities (Baltimore, Louisville, Lexington, Paducah) on Turn 1 to maximize early income and establish defensive anchors.
Fortify Louisville and Washington to level 2; fort defense multipliers shatter superior Rebel doomstacks repeatedly.
Join field armies into 50,000-120,000 man doomstacks under top commanders (Grant, Sherman, Rosecrans) before striking deep into Confederate territory.
Never attack heavily garrisoned level-2 fortified capitals (Richmond); bypass them to capture exterior cities and win via 28 cities or 60% income.
Protect the Northeast corridor (Philadelphia, Baltimore, Washington, Harper's Ferry); eliminate adjacent raiders immediately.
Guard and immediately recapture Midwest rail hubs (St. Louis, Indianapolis, Cincinnati, Columbus) to maintain vital reinforcement networks.
Cut off Rebel retreat paths into adjacent friendly cities before attacking to force complete surrenders of trapped enemy forces.
Resupply armies whenever supply drops to 1, particularly prior to seasonal attrition turns (Jan, Mar, May, Nov); never march with 0 supply.
Rail reserve corps directly to threatened border bastions (Louisville, Washington) to intercept incoming Rebel thrusts.
Maintain continuous fleet commerce raiding from Turn 1, and rebuild sunk ships to ensure ongoing economic attrition against Rebel cash.
